# Apple macOS 27 SDK vs BifrOSt: index and parity matrix

Generated by `bifrost pc parity build` from `docs/parity-matrix/` (do not edit by hand; edit the data files).
What BifrOSt has built against each framework Apple documents for macOS 27 (Golden Gate), and what remains.
Apple side: the official developer documentation only (developer.apple.com DocC data, read with
`tools/parity/docc.py`; each framework page was also rendered in Chromium and recorded with REA, whose
`evidence_id` is listed per framework). BifrOSt side: code and docs in this repo, cited by path; a cited path that
does not exist is marked "(not found)". Rows were filled by agents; treat a row as a pointer to check.

Status: **Parity** app-facing API covers the main features; **Partial** some features; **OS only** the system
layer has it but apps get no SDK API; **Gap** relevant to a macOS-style desktop and missing; **n/a** tied to
Apple-only hardware, stores, services or other platforms. Coverage: rows that apply score Parity 1, Partial and
OS only 0.5, Gap 0, divided by the rows that apply (n/a rows excluded). AppKit, Foundation, SwiftUI and AVFoundation
are split into parts by their official topic sections.

## Summary: created vs remaining

- Coverage over all applicable feature rows: **73.4%** (1974 applicable of 2449 rows).
- Built (Partial or Parity) share of applicable rows: **99.0%**; the deploy gate is 80%.
- Frameworks and parts assessed: **246**.
- Created: **187** (Parity 0, Partial 171, OS only 16).
- Remaining: **0** Gap, plus the missing features inside the 171 Partial ones.
- Not applicable: **59**.

## Remaining work (Gap and Partial, lowest coverage first)

### App Frameworks

- **RelevanceKit** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing relevance hint API for desktop widgets or the Today view's Smart Stack (the shell's Smart Stack pages members in fixed order, springboard/src/shell/today.rs:574).; No donation API: apps cannot tell the shell which intents are likely useful at a given time (springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs has invocation only).; Time-based relevance is the only clue type that could map to a desktop (time or date windows); location, fitness, sleep and headphones depend on watch hardware or services BifrOSt does not expose.; Decision needed: whether a desktop relevance hint is worth building, since Apple scopes the API to watchOS.
- **AppKit (Graphics, Drawing, Color, and Printing)** (Partial, 53%): Page Setup and accessory views: the shell print sheet has printer, paper, orientation, scale and copies rows, but no page layout panel and no accessory view controllers (print_panel.rs PageSetup is a model only).; NSImage drawing in the kit: image widgets do not draw an ImageObject in a tint yet (tint_template exists in image_object.rs), and there are no per-codec representation classes (TIFF, GIF, WebP, HEIC).; Colour well and picker modes that use colour lists; User accent colour feeding controlAccentColor; remaining NSColor names
- **AppKit (User Interactions)** (Partial, 56%): Touchpad scroll phases and momentum, and trackpad magnify and rotate from the compositor: the Wayland layer sends a notched vertical wheel only and binds no pointer-gestures protocol; Cursor art (cursor_art.rs) is not yet drawn by the compositor; the SDK cursor service pushes shapes that the shell does not show with the outline and fill colour setting yet; Dock tile content beyond the progress bar (a custom contentView); No shipped view or app takes the new pointer events or the view-kit drag and drop yet; files dropped on a view arrive as grants, not bytes
- **Bundle Resources** (Partial, 61%): Privacy declarations are a model only: the shell does not load privacy.toml from installed packages, nothing shows it to people, and the store does not check it (springboard/ui/src/privacy.rs).; Universal links are not live: the association file is not fetched or verified over https, and the shell does not route https links to apps (springboard/sdk/src/bundle_resources.rs holds only the model).; bundle_info reads Info.plist and manifest.toml with CFBundle keys, but the shell and installer still parse manifest.toml with their own readers and no package ships an Info.plist.; URL-scheme routing by the shell is not wired for non-web schemes (docs/default-apps.md, Not done yet).
- **SwiftUI (Views, View layout)** (Partial, 62%): Declarative View protocol with body, modifiers and state/binding updates; Style protocols; Layout protocol (custom Layout types). Lazy grid views (LazyVGrid) have no SDK view: the window model is in ui lazy_stack only; Declarative Shape and Canvas views: the drawing API exists imperatively (sdk graphics_context Path and GraphicsContext, ShapeView, ui shape), but no Shape protocol or Canvas view builder in the view tree
- **Accessibility** (Partial, 66%): The sidebar, toolbar and sheet draw accessibility groups; the menu, the other immediate-mode kit helpers and non-view apps still publish flat lists.; Shell chrome is in the AT-SPI tree but read-only (press is not routed back) and Spotlight has no live text.; The AT-SPI bridge is untested on a live Orca; unit tests cover only wire round trips and mapping.; Spoken Content: Speak Items Under the Pointer is not built (the shell has no pointer-hover text source). Speak Selection (Option+Escape) is built.
- **Symbols** (Partial, 70%): No symbol-effect API: appear, bounce, disappear, pulse, scale, variableColor, replace and automatic cannot be applied to a glyph; No discrete or indefinite effect protocols and no SymbolEffectOptions (repeat, speed) for starting or stopping a looping effect; No content transition for swapping one symbol for another; a glyph change is a plain redraw; No draw-on and draw-off, breathe, rotate or wiggle effects; glyphs have no stroke-progress or per-layer state
- **AppKit (User Interface)** (Partial, 71%): App-facing speech synthesis and haptics API (sdk system_sound SystemSounds::named gives synthesised system tones); NSScreen-style multi-display API for apps; App dock tile badges/menus and custom cursors; Full accessibility roles and rotors
- **SwiftUI (App structure, Data and storage)** (Partial, 71%): No declarative App/Scene/View protocol tree; No view tree reads environment values or preference keys. The models exist: springboard/ui/src/environment.rs (Environment, scoped, with_value; tests) and springboard/ui/src/preferences.rs (PreferenceKey, Preferences; tests), but no view binds them.; No SwiftData/Core Data style model store; No desktop widgets or app extension points
- **Foundation (Files and Data Persistence)** (Partial, 73%): Midget check of the new file APIs (all rows stay partial until then); On-disk purgeable data; iCloud / cloud-synced documents and key-value store; File versions
- **AppKit (App Structure)** (Partial, 75%): Cocoa Bindings controllers and declarative bindings; nib/storyboard-style resource loading; General app extension host and packaging; iCloud-style document and key-value sync API
- **Foundation (Networking, Low-Level Utilities)** (Partial, 75%): Bonjour mDNS responder (advertise on the wire); wss:// WebSocket and StartSecureConnection on stream tasks; Client-certificate and server-trust challenges. Digest is parsed and answered headless (sdk http_digest.rs), but ConfiguredSession does not send it yet.; OS-level background transfers
- **Foundation Models** (Partial, 77%): The SystemLanguageModel API is in the SDK (sdk language_model.rs), but no on-device model is installed, so availability is always Unavailable and apps cannot generate text on the device.; No generation options (such as temperature or a token limit) and no streamed partial output in springboard/ui/src/model_session.rs; Session::respond returns a whole reply.; Guided generation is a prompt plus a read-back check (springboard/ui/src/generation_schema.rs); output is not constrained while decoding, and no local model runs.; No model-invoked tool calling; App Intents (springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs) exist but are not exposed to a model.
- **Core Foundation** (Partial, 78%): No CFURL value type for paths (appending or deleting components, standardizing); springboard/sdk/src/file_manager.rs covers paths, resource values and directory enumeration.; UserDefaults (defaults.rs) is not yet backed by PrefStore domains; no suite or global-domain fallback for the per-app store.; Calendar/TimeZone are not yet used by DateFormatter (it takes an explicit tz_offset).
- **AppKit (Text)** (Partial, 79%): Multi-line text view widget (NSTextView) (model, find bar and layout exist; no shell widget draws them yet); TextKit layout manager and text containers (layout manager exists on the ui layer; no glyph generation, no custom fragment providers); Paragraph styles, text lists, tables and attachments in attributed text (modelled in bifrost-ui; attributed strings in the SDK do not carry them yet); Writing Tools integration for text views
- **PaperKit** (Partial, 79%): No app-facing SDK markup API: no view controller, no markup data model, no shared type. Apps cannot embed a markup canvas.; No vector elements: shapes, text boxes, images, links and loupes are all missing; every mark is a raster stamp.; No editable, reloadable markup document; the shell and Freeform save a flattened PNG and discard the strokes.; No stroke selection or editing, no stylus pressure or tilt.
- **Distributed** (Partial, 80%): No location-transparent remote actor references or actor system; no SDK type for a remote handle to another app's object; No typed remote-call encoder or decoder: control methods pass untyped JSON params and results; No local test double for cross-process calls (LocalTestingDistributedActorSystem equivalent); Cross-app notifications are string-to-string only, capped at 32 entries and 1024 characters per value
- **SwiftUI (Event handling, Accessibility, Framework integration)** (Partial, 81%): Live-region announcements and custom actions reach the model only: bifrost_ui::ax has Announcements and add_custom_action (tests ax::tests), and custom rotors are in sdk/src/accessibility_rotor.rs (tests in ui/src/ax_rotor.rs); no SDK call posts an announcement.; Declarative gesture composition; Focused values across scenes; User activity/handoff
- **Foundation (App Support)** (Partial, 83%): Publishing progress to other processes and value observation for views: ui/src/progress.rs has the ProgressTree model, the SDK does not expose it, and nothing publishes progress across processes.; Per-domain error user info providers and a recovery attempter: sdk/src/error.rs (AppError) keeps the recovery options, and the caller runs the chosen one; no attempter runs it.; NSUserActivity Handoff between devices; Generic app extension host: sdk/src/item_provider.rs loads typed representations (NSItemProvider style), but there is no extension host to load them from other apps.
- **StateReporting** (Partial, 83%): No derive or macro attaches a struct's fields to reportable metadata; the dictionary type exists (ui/src/state_report.rs).; Crash logs are not linked to app state; a crash carries only a signature and file path (springboard/src/shell/diag.rs).; No app-facing metric payload delivered to the developer comparable to MetricKit.; State reports are queued in memory (ui/src/state_report.rs, exposed as bifrost_app state_reporting) but no transport delivers them to the shell or to a developer yet.
- **Visual Intelligence** (Partial, 83%): No system delivery of camera or screenshot scenes to third-party apps (the core of the framework).; App return path is a model only: sdk visual_search::VisualSearchProvider answers a Scene with Matches, and search() stamps each match with the provider app id (tests in sdk/src/visual_search.rs); the shell does not call it yet.; Scene labels and pixels exist (ui visual_search::Scene::new, with_labels, pixel); the caller supplies the labels, nothing classifies the scene.; Object selection exists as Scene::crop(PixelRect) in ui visual_search; no screenshot UI feeds it yet.
- **Music Understanding** (Partial, 85%): Pace and section labels: pace is a model in ui/src/music.rs (analyze_pace from a beat grid) that the session does not run yet; structure gives segment boundaries only, with no section labels or phrases.; Instrument activity detection and source separation.; Loudness: the session gives integrated and maximum momentary and short-term LUFS over whole buffers; there is no streaming meter, and true peak is still DAW-only.; No streaming input: analyze_interleaved (sdk/src/music_understanding.rs) takes a whole buffer, and the decoders return whole files.
- **SwiftData** (Partial, 88%): No model layer: no declarative model type, schema, or SDK-level container and context for persistent objects.; No queryable record store: no predicate or sort-descriptor fetch over persistent records, and no live results that update views.; No index constraints: uniqueness (ui model_store.rs declare_unique) and relations (ui relations.rs) are modelled, but no app store uses them.; No pluggable data store interface and no store-level batching.
- **Foundation (Fundamentals)** (Partial, 91%): Regular expression and natural-language text analysis API; Non-Gregorian week/era arithmetic beyond the supported components; Progress tree (ProgressManager, Subprogress); NSNumber and value wrappers, key-value coding and a serialisation trait for the value types. IndexSet, OrderedSet, CountedSet, Decimal and Uuid are built
- **Observation** (Partial, 92%): No derive for the @Observable macro: model properties are listed in observable_model!, and there is no per-property opt-out. with_observation_tracking tracks only SDK Observable reads.; No withContinuousObservation(options:apply:), ObservationTracking.Options, Event or Token: with_observation_tracking is one-shot and returns only the closure value.; Observations is pull-based (try_next), not an AsyncSequence; there is no executor or suspension in the pure std model.; docs/bifrost-ui.md:1435 still describes the old re-entrant set limit; that shared doc is out of scope for this change and is listed for a later update.
- **Evaluations** (Partial, 93%): No model-quality evaluation harness: no suite definition, sample runner or scoring for the Assistant or any on-device model feature.; No datasets, loaders or synthetic sample generation for model tests.; No metric, evaluator or aggregation types, and no model-judge scoring.; No tool-call trajectory checks for agentic features.
- **Swift** (Partial, 94%): Actor isolation and async/await for apps (no actor type in the SDK; springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs is callback-based); Regex builder or regex matching API for app text search; Distributed actors (remote calls between app processes); withObservationTracking-style automatic dependency capture in springboard/sdk/src/observable.rs

### App Services

- **Core Motion** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing service for device motion: the SDK re-exports DeviceMotionManager and the shell's SensorFeed (springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs) uses it, but no app reads device motion through a shell service.; No magnetometer, barometer or altitude readers.; No motion-activity recognition, pedometer or sensor recording or history.
- **MatterSupport** (Partial, 50%): No smart-home ecosystem or accessory setup flow; No Thread stack; the Matter model (springboard/core/src/matter*.rs) is pure and has no network transport
- **Notification Center** (Partial, 50%): No app-drawn widget view: apps send a title, a value, live date text and buttons (springboard/sdk/src/widgets_timeline.rs); the shell draws the row, and the today_widgets WidgetSet only orders widgets and keeps has-content flags.; No search results view or list view for widgets (NCWidgetSearchViewController, NCWidgetListViewController).; The Block, Controller and DisplayMode layout in springboard/ui/src/widget_column.rs (layout, block_at) is still not called by the shell; the column places widget rows with widget_column::flow.; WidgetKit (Apple's replacement) is not in the SDK; it is outside this framework but is where Apple's widget work now lives.
- **Quick Look** (Partial, 50%): The shell draws the floating preview panel for ToShell::Preview and the quick-look service, and the panel is resizable and has a full-screen button. Not yet checked on Midget.; No app uses the SDK PreviewPanel or ThumbnailCache. Files keeps its own preview (springboard/apps/files/src/peek.rs).; Only one third-party preview provider exists: Notes (Markdown, preview.render). QLPreviewProvider replies that carry HTML, PDF or file data do not reach the shell; only a PNG path does.; The panel has no Markup button in the shell panel (Files keeps its own), and no QLPreviewView embedding.
- **QuickLook UI** (Partial, 50%): The shell draws the Quick Look panel (ToShell::Preview and PreviewClose, and the quick-look service). Not yet checked on Midget.; Preview providers run only in the Files process (springboard/ui/src/preview.rs, wired in springboard/apps/files/src/peek.rs); no separate extension process supplies HTML, PDF or file replies to the shell.; QLPreviewView is a model only (springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs PreviewView holds the item, style and switches); no embeddable view is drawn for apps.; The SDK has no built-in file renderers for QLThumbnailGenerator; each app renders its own thumbnails.
- **WidgetKit** (Partial, 53%): No separate widget extension process: apps register kinds (register or [[widget]] tables) and answer reload events themselves; there is no WidgetBundle or declarative configuration type for apps (widget_kind::WidgetBundle exists as a model only).; Widget buttons run over the app's control socket, so the app must be running; there is no start-on-demand extension (Button, Toggle and AppIntent inside a widget extension).; Timeline API for apps exists (reload, reload_rich, register) but there is no WidgetCenter.reloadAllTimelines call from an app into the shell; shell tiles refresh themselves only.; No Live Activity API (ActivityKit, ActivityConfiguration, DynamicIsland); the lock screen shows shell now-playing only.
- **Core Transferable** (Partial, 56%): Transferable and TransferRepresentation exist in the SDK (Sprint 10) but are not yet adopted by apps; verify on Midget before marking parity.; The Wayland clipboard publishes only one rich type at a time (springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs:33), so typed pasteboard data does not reach other apps in full.; Shell follow-up: springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs publishes one type to the Wayland selection and keeps items flat; it needs multi-MIME data sources and item grouping so the SDK's multi-representation writes (NativePasteboard::write_items) reach other apps in full, plus file promises for file representations.; no derive-style CodableRepresentation (encoders are passed as functions); a proc-macro crate would be needed.
- **Contacts** (Partial, 57%): No containers (CNContainer). Groups and subgroups exist in the SDK (contacts::groups).; The Contacts app edits one phone, one email and one address; the SDK and the contacts service carry labeled phones, emails and URLs, a birthday and dates. No relations, social profiles, instant messages or nicknames.; The access sheet and a Contacts Settings group exist (services/privacy_permissions.rs); the shell sets grants, and they reset on restart.; Apps can build and parse vCards through the SDK vcard module; the Contacts app's import and export still run on springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/exchange.rs, and no SDK import UI exists.
- **JavaScriptCore** (Partial, 57%): No SDK type for a standalone JavaScript context (JSContext equivalent), so apps cannot run scripts without a web view; No way to expose app objects or functions to scripts (JSExport equivalent); No value bridge between app code and script values beyond text and JSON strings from a web view; No syntax check and no standalone script error reporting outside a web view
- **WebKit** (Partial, 60%): No WebDriver implementation for web content (Apple's WebDriver commands for Safari); the testing kit is XCTest-style only.; No WKDOMNodeSnapshot equivalent: no DOM tree snapshot object.; No navigation policy callback (per-request allow or cancel), and stop_loading does nothing because Servo 0.7.0 cannot cancel a load.; No alert, confirm, prompt or file-chooser UI delegate, and no select element support.
- **User Notifications UI** (Partial, 62%): App-supplied notification view (UNNotificationContentExtension) with a view controller that renders delivered content; Media play and pause controls on a notification (mediaPlayPauseButton* and mediaPlay()/mediaPause()); Content-extension response options (UNNotificationContentExtensionResponseOption) and dismissal behaviour per action; Notification attachments and userInfo payloads for custom content (noted in docs/bifrost-ui.md, User notifications section)
- **Core Spotlight** (Partial, 65%): Streamed found-items replies are not built: CSSearchQuery gets all hits at once. The query language (ui quicksearch_query.rs) has attribute comparisons, wildcards, && and \|\|.; The shell does not pull from an index extension on protection-class or throttling events; it asks once per run when an app has no items. CSImportExtension is not built.; The default index is one JSON file per app, sealed with the shell's key (spotindex.rs), with oldest-first eviction at 1000 items; the named-index descriptions carry only the name and protection class.; The Foundation models search tool is a model only: SpotlightSearchTool is not offered to the assistant app, and the pipeline types (SearchSource, CustomStage, SearchResultsTable and the rest) are not modelled.

### Developer Tools

- **Automator** (Partial, 79%): The workflow model exists (sdk workflow.rs, ui workflow.rs: ordered steps, each output feeds the next step); the action library and an Automator app are missing.; Shortcuts actions that need the shell (Wi-Fi, Low Power, Do Not Disturb, brightness, open app, screenshot, timer) are logged, not executed (springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/main.rs).; No action bundle format or install scan: no equivalent of /System/Library/Automator, /Library/Automator or ~/Library/Automator.; The workflow controller runs, steps, resumes, stops and resets a workflow (ui workflow.rs); there is no runWorkflow-by-path API.
- **App Intents Testing** (Partial, 82%): No intent test helpers: no test session that runs an intent by type and returns a checked result (dispatch() is public but returns raw Json).; No value query results or intent value queries (ResolvedValueQueryResult, IntentValueQueryDefinition).; No entity annotation or onscreen context (ViewAnnotation), so Spotlight and Siri cannot be told what is on screen.; No enum parameter type and no transient entities (AnyAppEnum, AnyTransientAppEntity).
- **Scripting Bridge** (Partial, 86%): Scripting dictionaries are declared in manifest.toml ([[script.command]], [[script.class]]), not as sdef files, and there are no generated client proxies; the tell-block language resolves commands through them (springboard/core/src/script/dictionary.rs).; The control socket accepts only the owning user (SO_PEERCRED), so one app cannot script another app that runs under a different account.; No explicit activate or launch-flag options when a caller starts an app; open_with only starts an installed app by id.
- **Synchronization** (Partial, 100%): No SDK wrapper for Mutex with closure-scoped withLock and withLockIfAvailable; apps use std::sync::Mutex guards directly; No WordPair or double-word atomic in the SDK or the UI, render or core crates; No SDK-level atomic wrapper or documented memory-ordering API; apps reach std::sync::atomic directly; No atomic reference type equivalent to AtomicLazyReference beyond std OnceLock

### Graphics and Games

- **ColorSync** (Partial, 50%): Profile writing covers matrix-shaper and grey profiles, curves, gamma tables and arbitrary raw tags (icc_write::MutableProfile, embedding in PNG, JPEG and TIFF); lookup-table (A2B and B2A) tags are not authored, and the PDF writer embeds no profile.; CMYK and other non-RGB device profiles do not convert; matrix profiles get a luminance-preserving perceptual gamut compression, with no saturation intent distinct from relative colorimetric.; The PDF ICCBased path (springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/image.rs) is drawn by component count and does not use the profile.; No display profile path to the hardware: kms.rs reads gamma_size but loads no vcgt ramp, the EDID profile is not registered as the device profile, and Night Shift does not use the display profile.

- **MetalKit** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing GPU view with a per-frame delegate (MTKView and MTKViewDelegate equivalent) in springboard/sdk/src/; No app-facing GPU texture loader (MTKTextureLoader equivalent); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs decodes on the CPU only; No app-facing mesh API: the mesh model and loader (ui/src/mesh.rs, mesh_file.rs, render/src/mesh.rs) are not re-exported by bifrost_app and no GPU path draws a mesh.; Presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs) is shell-internal; its Metal-shaped API has no SDK binding
- **PencilKit** (Partial, 50%): The SDK canvas view (bifrost_app::canvas_view::CanvasView) exists but no app uses it yet: Notes' sketch pad, Freeform and the shell markup keep their own stroke code.; Shell and Freeform save flattened PNG only; Notes saves the text form; CanvasView::data_representation gives apps the serialised drawing.; No handwriting recogniser: the line layout and Recognizer hook exist in springboard/ui/src/handwriting.rs, but nothing recognises letters.; No Scribble input path into text fields: the gesture model exists in springboard/ui/src/scribble.rs, but nothing routes stylus strokes to views.
- **Metal Performance Shaders** (Partial, 53%): No app-facing GPU compute or image-filter API. The GPU path (springboard/src/gpu/) serves the shell only.; No app-facing convolution with a caller kernel and no app-facing image statistics; plane_stats is shell-side. Histogram, threshold, morphology, median, Sobel and Laplacian are app-facing in sdk pixel_filter (2026-10-17).; No graph object and no GPU path for neural network layers. CPU layers exist (ui cnn_layers: convolution, pooling, dense, relu, LSTM and GRU steps; sdk core_ml: dense, relu and softmax models), but apps cannot build a graph or serialise a model beyond its text form.; No GPU matrix or linear algebra kernels. CPU vector, matrix and quaternion types are in sdk linear_algebra.
- **Core Graphics** (Partial, 55%): No drawing context that writes PDF pages: the SDK PdfWriter draws rectangles, lines, paths, text in the four standard faces and images through its own page calls, not through DrawContext.; Most of the cg tree is not used by apps yet: the graphics_* SDK wrappers, shadings, patterns, Boolean path operations and CgImage have no app caller.; Boolean path operations return polygons (curves are flattened), not curves.; Wide-gamut and ICC output: the Surface stays 8-bit sRGB; no HDR, CMYK or 16-bit drawing.
- **Quartz** (Partial, 57%): No SDK image view or image browser for apps (ImageKit IKImageView and IKImageBrowserView); image viewing exists only inside the Photos shell app.; No parameterised image filter API (Core Image CIFilter) and no filter browser; Photos has five fixed colour filters.; No scanner support (IKScannerDeviceView) and no SDK camera device browser or picture taker.; The Quick Look panel model in springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs is drawn by the shell for ToShell::Preview (src/shell/preview_panel.rs), but no app adopts it; no QLPreviewView.
- **Image I/O** (Partial, 60%): No XMP or IPTC metadata in the SDK; the metadata block carries EXIF, TIFF and GPS only.; HEIC, TGA and RAW are not recognised by the codecs; WebP is read only.; The Photos and camera code still use their own encoders (springboard/src/pngenc.rs writes uncompressed PNG) and are not moved onto picture_writer.; APNG frame access is not verified.
- **Core Animation** (Partial, 62%): No CALayer class hierarchy for apps: sdk layers.rs exposes LayerTree and LayerBatch, but layers are otherwise reached through ViewBase::layer and the layer-kind views.; No keyframe, group or additive animations driven by the SDK window (keypath_anim.rs and keyframe models exist but are not the SDK's animate path).; No key-path animations through Window::animate (typed view properties only).; Gradient, text, replicator and emitter layers render through layer-kind views; per-property parity is not yet checked on Midget.

- **ReplayKit** (Partial, 83%): No screen video recording for apps, the shell or the MCP tools (screen streams deliver one frame per event, sdk screen_stream.rs, and nothing encodes a movie).; No SDK API for recording: no RPScreenRecorder equivalent in springboard/sdk/src/.; Microphone recording (springboard/src/media/capture.rs) is not reachable from app SDK code; it is used by Voice Memos only.; No app or system audio capture; audiod does not loop back output.

### Media

- **Core Video** (Partial, 50%): Pixel buffers are not shared with the presenter: the GPU path still allocates its own GBM buffers, so an app cannot render into a presenter drawable.; The display link has no per-display output callback, no CVDisplayLinkCreateWithActiveCGDisplays equivalent, and no link to KMS vsync; the app drives it with its own ticks.; Decoded video pictures (springboard/src/media/mod.rs DmaPicture) carry no colour primaries, transfer function or YCbCr matrix, so the attachment model is not yet fed by the decoder.; The texture cache is not connected to the presenter's GL context: no app call imports a pixel buffer as a GPU texture.
- **DeviceDiscoveryExtension** (Partial, 50%): No system device picker or route picker view that lists third-party media receivers; the SDK feed is not wired to a shell browse service.; No sandboxed extension process or transport that feeds the modeled discovery point.; AirPlay & Handoff exists only as a settings page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) with no receiver discovery behind it.
- **AVFAudio** (Partial, 54%): No app-facing audio session category, mode or activation API (AVAudioSession): modelled in audio_session.rs, not wired to audiod; Route changes reach apps (shell, audiod, audio::Client, SessionHub::apply_service_route); interruptions are modelled in audio_session.rs and not arbitrated in audiod.; AVAudioApplication permission and input mute: modelled in audio_application.rs, not wired to the shell or the recording path; The node graph (ui audio_engine.rs: player, gain, mixer and low-pass nodes, exposed as bifrost_sdk::audio_engine) has no verified real-time output path on Midget.
- **Quick Look Thumbnailing** (Partial, 56%): Provider extensions answer with a PNG path only; no data or drawing-callback replies; Thumbnails are not drawn for Desktop icons or Dock stacks; No Live Photo or USDZ thumbnails (no such files on the PC); No app calls ThumbnailGenerator yet; Files asks the thumbnails service directly
- **Audio Unit** (Partial, 56%): Plug-ins load in-process through our own C ABI (springboard/audio/units/src/plugin.rs); there is no AU v2 or v3 binary compatibility and no extension process, and the DAW rack does not load them yet.; The unit and render API is bifrost_app::audio_engine (Engine and its units module); the DAW still renders and runs its devices internally.; MIDI input for apps is bifrost_app::midi_client; the DAW still uses its own MIDI path.; The audio service (springboard/audiod) has an SDK client (springboard/sdk/src/system_audio.rs) and a command-line client (bifrost-audio), but no app uses the SDK client yet.
- **Core MIDI** (Partial, 56%): Not verified on Midget: the device path (ALSA rawmidi in and out) and the client socket are built (bifrost-midid, MidiClient) but the BLE GATT link is not.; MIDI-CI has a transport over the MIDI server (MidiCiLink) but no subscription messages and no property exchange over a live link.; No MIDI network sockets or mDNS discovery; the RTP-MIDI session packets are not sent or received.; Hotplug is a two-second rescan of /dev/snd in midid (SetupChanged to clients), not a udev or kernel event; not verified on Midget.
- **CoreAudioKit** (Partial, 58%): Third-party units load in-process through our own C ABI (springboard/audio/units/src/plugin.rs) but supply no view of their own, so there is no AUViewController equivalent.; The generic view is a model (springboard/sdk/src/audio_unit_view.rs) that nothing draws yet; there is no panner view for plug-ins.; No BLE MIDI radio path for apps: the picker and the advertiser are models (springboard/ui/src/midi_ble_picker.rs, MidiPicker and MidiAdvertiser; tests midi_ble_picker::tests), not connected to the Bluetooth controller or any app.; Bluetooth audio streaming (A2DP/AVDTP) is not handled in springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs, so a device picker would list devices that cannot carry audio yet.
- **Screen Saver** (Partial, 61%): No screen saver plug-in host: no .saver bundle loading and no engine that calls the view lifecycle (start, animate, stop).; No preview or configuration sheet for screen savers in Settings wired to a module; ConfigureSheet is a model only.; Idle state reaches apps only through IdleWatch with caller-supplied times; the shell does not yet deliver its last-input time to apps.; Display-sleep hold (IDLE_DISPLAY_SLEEP_DISABLED) has no app option; the SDK activity tracker in springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs covers system sleep only.
- **Audio Toolbox** (Partial, 64%): No SDK API for raw audio buffers or render callbacks; apps can only use transport and record calls on the audio service; No audio unit or audio component host (AUv3 or AUv2), and no parameter tree; No system sound playback: the SDK model (sdk/src/system_sound.rs) exists but the audio service does not call take_request, so it never plays.; No general format converter or encoder API for apps
- **ImageCaptureCore** (Partial, 64%): No PTP or USB camera enumeration reaches the device browser (ui device_browser). sdk device_registry::DeviceWatch polls sysfs devices by class and could feed it.; No PTP or MTP transport, so no camera file listing, download, delete or tethered capture (ICCameraDevice, ICCameraFile).; No per-app USB device grant to match com.apple.security.device.usb in springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs.; Camera permission model: no usage-description string or prompt for camera access, unlike NSCameraUsageDescription.
- **Core Audio** (Partial, 64%): Virtual audio device publication: no user-space plug-in loader, and no ALSA loopback or PipeWire node reaches apps (AudioHardwarePlugin, Audio Server Plug-in). The SDK model in audio_virtual.rs is not connected to the sound server.; No app-facing stream I/O: springboard/sdk/src/audio_hal.rs models devices and streams from the PCM listing, but apps cannot open an input or output stream.; Device property listeners for default device, sample rate and volume changes (AudioHardwareObject.addPropertyListener).; Audio box enable and acquire state is not applied to hardware (AudioHardwareBox); audio_box.rs is a model only.
- **Media Library** (Partial, 64%): No source enumeration for apps: springboard/sdk/src/media_library.rs runs queries over records the app supplies (groups and sections), but nothing lists Music or Photos sources or scans a library for an app.; No source abstraction: Music and Photos each scan their own folders with their own code (springboard/src/shell/photos/library.rs and springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs).; Photo scanning is in the shell (springboard/src/shell/photos/library.rs), not in the SDK, so other apps cannot reuse it.; The typed attribute dictionary (springboard/ui/src/media_attributes.rs) exists, but neither Music nor Photos uses it yet; metadata is still per-app structs.
- **PhotoKit** (Partial, 66%): No asset creation and no user collections in the SDK. isFavorite is read from the asset record (is_favorite in springboard/sdk/src/photo_library.rs), so the old "always false" statement is stale.; The picker call exists (PHPickerViewController), but the shell refuses it: there is no picker sheet yet, so apps fall back to their own picker.; No Live Photo support in the library or the viewer (PHLivePhoto).; Movie pixel size is not read (reported as 0 x 0); movies are listed as video assets.
- **AVKit** (Partial, 67%): Picture in Picture: no floating video window or PiP controller API in the shell; springboard/ui/src/pip_window.rs is a model only, and the Settings toggle pip_auto (springboard/src/shell/options.rs:72) is stored but never read by the shell.; App-facing video player view: the SDK player() widget (springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900) draws audio only; the fullscreen video HUD lives in springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs and is not reusable by other apps.; Route picker: springboard/ui/src/route_picker.rs and route_picker_view.rs are models only. No receiver discovery feeds them and nothing draws the picker; the AirPlay & Handoff page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) is a settings screen only.; Capture: springboard/ui/src/capture_view.rs is a model only. There is no SDK capture view or delegate in use, and the camera is a single shell app (springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs).
- **Core Audio Types** (Partial, 67%): Formats are still passed as loose integers to the speaker and decoders: StreamFormat (springboard/audio/types, springboard/sdk/src/audio_format.rs) exists, but no service uses it yet.; Channel layouts are modelled (springboard/ui/src/channel_layout.rs) but no layout tag or per-channel label is carried through the audio service.; No timestamp model beyond presentation and decode times in microseconds (no host time or sample time).; APAC is not supported; CodecId (springboard/audio/types/src/codec_id.rs) names linear PCM, AAC, MP3, FLAC and ALAC.
- **AVFoundation (Capture, Audio)** (Partial, 68%): App-facing capture API (session, device discovery, inputs and outputs) for camera and microphone; Per-app camera and microphone permission prompts; Audio engine graph with effects and buffers; Video recording to file and sample buffer outputs
- **Now Playing** (Partial, 69%): No app-facing local media session: an app cannot publish its own metadata, state and commands to the lock screen or Control Center (MediaSession, MediaSessionRepresentable).; No typed content model: the service track has no title, artist, kind, or artwork, so the lock card cannot show metadata from apps other than Music.; No artwork transport or animated artwork through the audio service.; No remote media sessions across devices, no remote session extension and no device list; the Bluetooth route is only shown as a name.
- **AVFoundation (Playback, Editing, Common)** (Partial, 71%): No SDK media player for apps (everything is in the shell crate); No SDK asset model for apps: springboard/src/media/movie.rs summarizes a movie inside the shell crate only, and there is no sample reader for apps.; No composition, video composition or audio mix editing; No writer or export session; no encoder
- **iTunes Library** (Partial, 71%): No SDK module exposes the Music library or playlists to other apps (no equivalent of ITLibrary).; Playlists are .m3u files readable only by the Music app; no read API, no distinguished playlists.; No library change notification; Music polls its folders instead of using fswatch.; Per-track play statistics (playCount, lastPlayedDate, rating) are not stored in the library model.
- **Media Player** (Partial, 72%): Media library queries are an SDK model over records the app supplies (sdk media_library.rs); no shell library is exposed, and there is no library change API (MPMediaQuery, MPMediaLibrary); the scan lives in springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs.; No media picker view for apps. springboard/ui/src/media_picker.rs models the picker (kinds, selection rules, search, confirm), but no SDK widget or shell sheet draws it.; No remote command handlers for apps (MPRemoteCommandCenter); Control Center transport and hardware media keys are not exposed to apps (springboard/src/bare/input.rs:826 notes the media-key remote but does not map it).; No playlist, rating or feedback model in the SDK (MPMediaPlaylist, MPRatingCommand); favourites and playlists are private to the Music app.
- **PHASE** (Partial, 79%): No HRTF or head-tracked binaural output: the listener model gives pan gains, distance and occlusion gains only.; SDK exposes only the playback client (springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87); the sampler and buses live inside the DAW app and are not reusable; Occlusion is a transmission gain over boxes (sound_space Occluder); no geometry or material acoustics.; Reverb: sound_room gives reverb time and critical distance, but no applied reverb or environment effect reaches the output.
- **Media Intelligence** (Partial, 80%): Face detection and person grouping for images, with a query API by asset, entity or face ID; Video highlight scoring (engaging segments) over decoded frames; Content-based keyframe selection (representative frame) beyond container sync samples; Media analysis errors for asset loading and video analysis (face grouping errors are typed)
- **AVRouting** (Partial, 81%): No system route picker or AirPlay-style destination list in the shell or SDK; No API for an app to register a third-party media receiver, its authorization, or its route activation state; No playback arbiter: apps cannot declare a preferred participant for external or non-mixable output; No discovery extension point for media receivers on the local network
- **Sound Analysis** (Partial, 81%): No sound classifier: no built-in label set (over 300 sounds) and no Core ML audio model path; No SDK audio input API: the audio service records to a file only (RecordStart and RecordStop), so apps cannot receive a live buffer stream; No analysis of audio files: springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs decodes files only; No result types for time-ranged classifications with confidences, and no observer delivery to apps
- **MediaExtension** (Partial, 86%): No public extension point for third-party format readers, video decoders or RAW processors.; No public track reader or sample cursor API for apps; sample cursors are internal to springboard/src/media/demux/.; No RAW image processing (camera RAW decode, processing parameters) in springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs.; Codec manifests (a property-list dictionary with FourCC, Name and Professional) are read and registered by bifrost_ui::codec_manifest; no extension ships a decoder through one yet.
- **Media Accessibility** (Partial, 93%): Caption appearance preferences: the model is in ui/src/captions.rs (profiles, text, highlight and window styles, change reporting; tests captions::tests); missing the settings page and an app-facing SDK call.; Caption and subtitle track support in the demuxers and the player (WebM drops subtitle tracks; MP4 has no text track), plus a caption renderer.; Audible media selection preferences: ui/src/media_selection.rs chooses tracks from them (tests media_selection::tests); no app-facing SDK call.; Image caption metadata API (set and read the accessibility caption of an image).

### System

- **Accessory Access** (Partial, 50%): No bus source calls attach and detach for USB accessories, so no app receives real hotplug events yet.; No USB device permission in the app permission manifest (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs), and no grant flow comparable to docbroker.rs for USB.; The accessory object's descriptors come from the caller; nothing reads them from a device.; No USB device nodes are bound into the app sandbox, so a listener cannot match a real accessory from an app.
- **Apple Archive** (Partial, 50%): BAR1 is not the Apple Archive container (AAR) byte format, field keys or stream protocols; the Files app and the Archive Utility still write ZIP; File flags, access control lists and creation time are not kept in archives; extended attributes, owner, mode and times are; No Apple-compatible encrypted archive profiles and no key derivation; sealing and signing take caller-held keys; A BAR tree is held in memory per archive (bounded by Limits), entries are not streamed one at a time
- **Compression** (Partial, 50%): No LZFSE or Brotli codec in either direction (LZ4 block and frame and LZMA2 in an xz container are implemented); Brotli needs a static dictionary that is not in the tree, LZFSE has no reference vectors here; LZMA streams buffer their input and run on finalize; DEFLATE, zlib and LZ4 streams are incremental with a flush; DEFLATE encoder has no optimal parsing and no table sharing across blocks; output is larger than zlib at its best level; PNG writer uses a fixed-Huffman deflate (springboard/src/pngenc.rs), not the SDK dynamic encoder
- **IOUSBHost** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing transport: the claim plan (springboard/sdk/src/usb_device.rs) is not sent and no control, bulk, interrupt or isochronous request reaches a device (IOUSBHostDevice, IOUSBHostInterface, IOUSBHostPipe, IOUSBHostStream).; The app sandbox (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs) does not bind USB device nodes, so a sandboxed app cannot reach raw USB even if an API existed.; No USB transport for printers (springboard/ui/src/print.rs); scanner sessions are an SDK model (sdk scan_session.rs) with no transport.; Owner decision needed: whether a desktop needs app-level raw USB access at all. The triage note says likely n/a; the framework's stated use cases (cameras, audio, scanners, printers, MIDI, hubs) are mostly covered at the system layer, which leaves custom device drivers as the real gap.
- **InputMethodKit** (Partial, 56%): No third-party input method provider process: a method must be a folder with an Info.plist and a built-in engine (BifrostEngine); nothing connects over the window server's input method protocol.; No dictionary conversion (kanji, hanja, pinyin candidates); Telex, VNI and the other composers in src/shell/input_methods are not hosted by the new Host.; Pointer clicks on the candidate window and clicks into the marked text are not forwarded (Host::pick_candidate and Host::mouse exist); editing commands from the menu do not go through Host::command.; The selected input mode is not saved across a restart and Ctrl+Space cycles the layouts only.
- **External Accessory** (Partial, 56%): The app view of an accessory (Accessory::from_core) has no bus source yet, and the sandbox binds no accessory device nodes.; No manifest key or sandbox grant for accessory protocols (app_policy.rs binds only /dev/snd and /dev/dri), so an app cannot reach a declared accessory. The EASession byte streams exist as a model (sdk external_accessory Session); The Bluetooth picker request model exists (sdk bluetooth_picker, tests bluetooth_picker::tests), but the request does not cross the shell boundary, so no app can open it; the pairing sheet stays in the shell; No Wi-Fi unconfigured accessory browser or configuration flow.
- **HIDDriverKit** (Partial, 61%): No app-facing API for HID elements or usage tables; raw reports are read through hidraw nodes (sdk hid_reports.rs); Stylus and pen data (pressure, tilt, eraser) is not decoded; Touch decoding tracks only the first contact (slot 0); No app-facing device matching or hotplug notification by HID usage
- **Service Management** (Partial, 62%): Launch agents and launch daemons are modelled but not loaded: SMAppService.agent(plistName:) and daemon(plistName:) find the plist in the bundle, and nothing starts it (no SDK API for root daemons shipped in an app bundle); Embedded helper executables are modelled (service_bundle.rs) but not scanned from the app bundle or shown in Login Items; wiring needs the shell to list helpers and report their enabled state; statusForLegacyPlist(at:) for earlier login-item plists: the pure model exists but BifrOSt has no earlier login-item plist format to check; Deprecated SMJobBless, SMLoginItemSetEnabled and the SMJob* launchd functions have no counterpart
- **IOBluetooth UI** (Partial, 64%): Apps list devices and read a pending pairing code through the SDK (bluetooth_service.rs), but pairing itself lives only in the Settings Bluetooth page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs).; No reusable device selector sheet or panel (IOBluetoothDeviceSelectorController).; No passkey or numeric comparison pairing: pairing is hardwired to NoInputNoOutput (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:68-69), so devices that need a PIN or passkey cannot pair.; No live SDP query: springboard/core/src/bt_service_browser.rs filters a service list it is given (UUID allow list, cancel); the radio service discovery is not implemented.
- **IOBluetooth** (Partial, 66%): App-facing Bluetooth SDK (springboard/sdk/src/bluetooth_service.rs) lists devices, scans, connects and reads a pending pairing code; apps cannot type the code (the shell asks the user) and cannot open RFCOMM or SDP.; No RFCOMM app API: the kernel stream is in springboard/src/bare/rfcomm.rs (channels must be known, since SDP is not queried), and no RFCOMM server side. No OBEX or SDP.; No hands-free (call control) profile.; No app API to open L2CAP channels to arbitrary PSMs. Device events are modelled in springboard/sdk/src/bluetooth_events.rs (DeviceEvents), but the shell does not deliver them to apps yet.
- **Darwin Notify** (Partial, 67%): No system-wide named notifications from the kernel or system services (time zone, clock, mount, network, disk space) to apps.; No notify_check, notify_register_signal, notify_set_state or notify_get_state equivalents.; No suspend or resume of observers, and no hold-for-later delivery to apps that are not running.; Observers always run on the main thread; no caller-chosen dispatch queue.
- **Accelerate** (Partial, 68%): No SDK module for vDSP, vImage, BNNS, BLAS/LAPACK, sparse solvers or simd.; No LZFSE or Brotli codec. The SDK compression module covers DEFLATE, zlib, LZ4 and LZMA (xz), and the PNG writer stores uncompressed blocks.; No neural network inference or training API for apps.; No small-vector, matrix or quaternion types exposed to the SDK.
- **Local Authentication Embedded UI** (Partial, 70%): No biometric authentication in the system layer, so there is no state for LAAuthenticationView to show (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Login window gaps: "no biometric or paired-device unlock").; LocalAuthenticationView (sdk view/local_auth_view.rs) draws the icon state; it stays idle until a biometric source exists; The login screen password flow (springboard/src/shell/login.rs) is the only authentication UI; it cannot show biometric state until a biometric source exists.
- **Force Feedback** (Partial, 71%): No effect reaches a controller yet: springboard/src/bare/pad_rumble.rs uploads effects (EVIOCSFF) and sends EV_FF play events (tests pad_rumble::tests), but nothing calls it, and springboard/src/bare/input.rs does not read EV_FF. Not verified on Midget; Device-level FF discovery is only a pure check (springboard/core/src/gamepad.rs supports_rumble, force_effect.rs supports_constant_force); the evdev node scan does not yet call it.; No SDK API for effects (constant, periodic, ramp, spring and friction) or for gain and autocenter properties.; The SDK haptic() call is dropped by the shell (springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs:1184 default arm); the per-app policy in springboard/core/src/haptic_request.rs has no caller yet.
- **Authentication Services** (Partial, 72%): Single sign-on: the browser app acting as a broker for other apps, with the shell routing callbacks through CallbackRoutes.; Web authentication session: a shell-run sign-in sheet that opens the page in an isolated session; the callback routing part is modelled by CallbackRoutes, but nothing presents the page yet.; Passkeys and FIDO2: a platform authenticator, public-key credential registration and assertion, and WebAuthn support in the browser (springboard/apps/browser/README.md lists WebAuthn as broken).; Shared credential store and AutoFill: keychain access groups (shared items between apps), a save-password prompt, and a credential provider for the browser and other apps.
- **Network** (Partial, 73%): No app-facing TCP client: sdk network_connection (Endpoint, Parameters, Connection) is a model that opens no socket; sdk network_listener and network_group bind real sockets for apps; Service browse has no socket query: sdk network_browser and core dns_browse take replies fed in by hand; No QUIC, WebSocket or custom protocol framer; No NWPathMonitor-style object: sdk network_path requests and decodes the shell path and DNS-SD replies, but no app subscribes to interface changes
- **Virtualization** (Partial, 74%): An SDK module that creates, starts, pauses and stops a Linux guest (VZVirtualMachine counterpart) with a sandboxed launcher; A guest display view that can be placed in a desktop window; Virtio device configuration for app-created guests: storage, network, entropy, memory balloon, serial console; Shared directories and clipboard bridging between host and guest
- **Exception Handling** (Partial, 75%): No app-facing process panic hook: an app captures failures with sdk exception_handler::ExceptionHandler::capture and lists them with crash_records; the panic hook stays with the shell; Halt mask only: hanging_mask is stored, but no debugger halt is performed; a panic aborts the release build after the hook writes; Panic isolation exists only in SDK dispatch and shell job pools, not for arbitrary app code
- **Open Directory** (Partial, 75%): LDAP directory nodes are read through ldapsearch (sdk ldap_directory.rs); there is no session object or node API for apps.; No directory-backed user lookup or sign-in; the local account directory (ui directory_local.rs) reads this machine only.; No SDK call to verify or change the password of another account.; Contacts app cannot search a directory server for people.
- **Security** (Partial, 75%): Trust evaluation is a model over Ed25519-signed links (springboard/sdk/src/trust.rs; shell springboard/src/shell/services/trust_eval.rs); there is no DER certificate parsing and no SecIdentity or client-certificate type.; Update manifests are not signed: springboard/ui/src/ed25519.rs verifies signatures, but the shell update path (springboard/src/shell/update.rs) checks only a digest and size, and apps are not code-signed.; Authorization Services: an app-facing authorization API for privileged operations; Keychain item classes beyond generic and internet passwords (no certificate or key classes); the data protection classes are not enforced at rest (feature 1)
- **XPC** (Partial, 75%): No SDK API for XPC-style typed sessions between an app and a helper (XPCListener, XPCSession, XPCReceivedMessage).; No app-facing way to declare a helper service that the system launches on demand and shuts down when idle. bifrostd only restarts services.; No XPC activity scheduler (criteria, intervals, deferral, system-run callback) in the SDK.; No endpoint objects for passing a connection to another process, and no peer requirement beyond the owner UID.
- **System** (Partial, 77%): File coordination is advisory and has no relinquish or save-negotiation step (springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs:1-20).; The file-change feed is polled, not pushed: the app calls the watch's deliver with the current time each tick and gets each batch through a callback (springboard/sdk/src/fswatch.rs:138); nothing wakes the app when a file changes.
- **FSKit** (Partial, 78%): No shell mount service or grant check for a user-space file system module (the read-only SDK module and FUSE session exist; write operations do not); No SDK volume and item model (FSVolume, FSItem) for the Files app or third-party apps; No probe, mount or maintenance request path for apps or daemons (FSClient equivalent); No FSTask-style channel from a file system module to the shell for log and completion events
- **System Configuration** (Partial, 81%): No system-wide preferences store for apps (SCPreferences), and no way to read or set the computer or host name.; Proxy settings are read from the environment the shell publishes (sdk proxy_settings.rs); no VPN or PPP connection control (SCNetworkConnection).; No network services, sets or locations, so service order and per-location settings do not exist.; The Network page cannot edit IPv4 or IPv6 settings (manual addressing, DNS servers).
- **Disk Arbitration** (Partial, 81%): No mount, unmount or eject events for apps. Appearance and disappearance callbacks are in springboard/sdk/src/disk_arbitration.rs; a mount change arrives only as a description change.; No mount, unmount or eject approval hook reaches apps; approvals stay on the shell side (bifrost_core::disk_events::Approvals).; No DADisk handle or lookup by volume path. The Disk struct in springboard/sdk/src/disk_arbitration.rs carries the description fields.; Files does not show mounted volumes or a Volumes sidebar section; document grants are confined to the account home.
- **Core Services** (Partial, 82%): Apple Events: typed inter-app messages with replies exist (app_events, dictionaries, osascript) but use JSON parameters rather than Apple event descriptors, and the scripting path is not yet verified on Midget.; File metadata: no attribute store or MDQuery-style query API for apps.; Backup Core: no per-item backup exclusion.; Identity Services: no user or group lookup for apps. springboard/sdk/src/identity_events.rs models ID-change events only, and no shell path calls it.
- **dnssd** (Partial, 83%): DNS-SD names and TXT records are an SDK model (sdk dns_service.rs); apps cannot browse, resolve or advertise arbitrary service types (for example _ipp._tcp or _airplay._tcp).; No mDNS on port 5353 and no DNS-SD PTR/SRV/TXT records, so ordinary LAN devices cannot find BifrOSt and BifrOSt cannot find them.; No TXT record encoding or parsing.; No DNSServiceRef-style connection to a discovery daemon, and no dispatch-queue integration for discovery callbacks.
- **Local Authentication** (Partial, 83%): No biometric authentication (Touch ID, Face ID, fingerprint). The SDK BiometryType always reports none; fprint, fprintd and howdy are absent.; Keychain items have no access control enforced: the protection class model (sdk keychain_protection.rs) is not applied at rest or in queries, so any item an app can read is readable without user presence (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Keychain, parity gaps).; No authentication-gated rights, persisted secrets or key pairs (LARight, LAPersistedRight, LASecret, LAPrivateKey).; There is no LADomainState: the device facts are the password_set flag and BiometryType, which is always none (sdk local_auth.rs).
- **Finder Sync** (Partial, 88%): No file-manager extension point: apps cannot add badges, context-menu items or toolbar buttons to Files.; No selection or targeted-folder API for other apps to query the file manager.; No per-item tag, last-used or attribute sharing with the file manager.; No extension host or enable UI for file-manager plugins.
- **MetricKit** (Partial, 88%): No app-facing report API: no MXMetricManager equivalent delivers daily metric reports or diagnostic reports to an app.; No per-app metric collection beyond ProcessInfo counters: time-in-use, launch and resume timing, network, disk and GPU totals are not kept per app (frame_metrics has no caller yet).; Crash and hang records are one-line log entries; the call-stack tree type exists (springboard/sdk/src/call_stack_tree.rs, tests call_stack_tree::tests) but no crash or hang record fills it.; No exception diagnostics for memory or CPU limit kills, and no termination counts by category.
- **Network Extension** (Partial, 89%): No VPN tunnel I/O: core tunnel.rs has the session state machine and the profile store (tests tunnel::tests), but no IKEv2, IPsec, WireGuard or packet-tunnel provider moves packets, and the VPN settings page is a static placeholder; No Wi-Fi join or add-network path reaches the radio. The configuration model exists (sdk hotspot_configuration: HotspotConfiguration, validation, consent in apply; tests in tests/parity_sdk-complete-01.rs), but nothing applies it and no app can call it; join and add-network stay shell-only; No content filter, URL filter or DNS proxy extension points for apps.; No system-wide encrypted DNS (DoH or DoT) settings; only DHCP-supplied resolvers are applied.
- **Uniform Type Identifiers** (Partial, 92%): Shell wiring: read the manifest type blocks at app launch and install the app type registry; Most of the system-declared identifiers on the landing page, including 3D, Apple-only, Shazam and bundle types; Type conversion between document types (writable types are built, see the document row; conversion rules are built in sdk type_conversion.rs (exact pairs, identity for ancestors; tests type_conversion::tests), but the save and open flow does not use them yet)
- **DiskImageKit** (Partial, 93%): No SDK API to create, open or mount disk image files (RAW or ISO) for apps. Apps cannot do what DiskImageKit does for a user opening an ISO or disk image in Files.; Files has no ISO or image mount action, and no removable or mounted-volume eject path (springboard/apps/files/src).; No loop-device or userspace mount service in the system layer exposed to apps. The loop mount in tools/arch-vm.sh is developer tooling only.; No image metadata, resize or block-size API.
- **LightweightCodeRequirements** (Partial, 93%): No code-signature verification of executables before launch or after download.; No signed identity (team or signing identifier) for apps, so identity cannot be tied to a developer.; No process peer identity check for control sockets or IPC (not verified; no SO_PEERCRED hits in the app host files).; No SDK API for apps to query identity, entitlements or validity of other code.
- **Security Interface** (Partial, 93%): No certificate panel, certificate view or certificate trust editor. The trust evaluation model is sdk trust.rs (ten tests in its module), with no UI; No choose-identity panel. Keychain items cannot hold identities, keys or certificates.; No keychain save or settings panel. The keychain SDK has no UI and no user-facing keychain settings.; No app-facing padlock: sdk system::authorization_lock holds the lock state, messages and privd password errors (tests in its module), but no SDK control draws it. The shell draws the only lock view and the privd password gate is not exposed to apps
- **CryptoTokenKit** (Partial, 94%): No smart card reader or PC/SC layer; springboard/ui/src/smartcard_slot.rs models slots and cards only.; No token driver or app extension mechanism for hardware tokens.; No way to store, list or use keys or certificates held by a token (keychain is generic-password only, per docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Keychain' section).; No token-based login or two-factor factor for springboard/src/shell/login.rs.
- **OSLog** (Partial, 94%): OSSignposter and signpost entries (phase 3 in docs/milestone-unified-logging.md); Activity, boundary and payload entry types and OSLogMessageComponent; Lazy OSLogEnumerator and persistent OSLogPosition tokens (LogStore::entries returns a Vec); Per-argument privacy (.public, .private(mask:)) and format specifiers; privacy is per subsystem only
- **GSS** (Partial, 96%): No GSS-API (RFC 2743/2744) implementation: no security contexts, credentials, names, tokens or message protection.; The Kerberos client runs the MIT tools (sdk krb5_client.rs: kinit and klist), but SPNEGO/Negotiate HTTP auth is unavailable to apps.; No SDK API for app-level GSS credentials; the keychain (springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs) stores generic passwords only.; No mechanism or name registry (gss_indicate_mechs, GSSCreateName), so apps cannot select or compare authentication mechanisms.
- **CFNetwork** (Partial, 96%): No cookie storage or URLCredential/HTTP authentication for URLSession apps (springboard/sdk/src/url.rs); No host name lookup API for apps (CFHost); the resolver stays inside springboard/src/deildu/http.rs; Proxy settings are read from the environment the shell publishes (sdk proxy_settings.rs); no system proxy store sits behind CFNetworkCopySystemProxySettings; No Bonjour or network service browse and register API (CFNetService)
- **Endpoint Security** (Partial, 97%): No system-level security event client: nothing connects to the kernel or the shell to receive process, file and session events.; No authorization hook: nothing can allow or deny an exec, open or mount before it happens.; Process events are limited to app launch and terminate from the shell; no exec arguments, environment, file descriptors, parent chain or processes outside the shell.; File events are content changes only, with no process attribution and no metadata, xattr or ACL events.
- **Dispatch** (Partial, 97%): DispatchSource beyond memory pressure: no timer, read, write, signal or process sources, and no cancel, suspend or resume (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1095); DispatchIO channels and DispatchData buffers; Barriers on concurrent queues and target queues (setTarget); concurrentPerform and asyncAndWait
- **os** (Partial, 100%): Signposts: no OSSignposter or os_signpost equivalent (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1041 names it as Phase 3); Per-value privacy and format specifiers: privacy is per subsystem only; Log reading: no persistent position tokens and the journal reader depends on journalctl; docs/bifrost-ui.md:1096 says no DispatchSource, but springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs:744 has a memory-pressure source; the doc needs a fix

### Web

- **Screen Time** (Partial, 64%): Web-usage and web-history models exist headless (springboard/sdk/src/web_usage.rs, web_history.rs) but no browser reports into them yet, so no visit is recorded on a device.; The web-history store is in memory; the browser that owns it has no persistence yet.; Web usage is not in the Settings chart, and the shield does not block URLs; the block list exists headless in springboard/sdk/src/web_usage.rs.; Limit state is not exposed to apps (only the app's own usage is, by springboard/sdk/src/screen_usage.rs); docs/bifrost-ui.md does not document the module yet.
- **Link Presentation** (Partial, 78%): No SDK function sends the request for a URL's metadata: link_metadata::LinkFetch holds the timeout and cancel state and parses the reply, but the app does the HTTP request. No video metadata.; The rich link row is drawn by the shared kit (springboard/ui/src/link_card.rs, from linkmeta::Card); no app shows it yet, and the share sheet has no rich preview.; The share sheet sends URLs as plain items and does not show a rich link preview

### Accessibility

Partial · coverage 66% · macOS 11.0 · [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accessibility) · REA `ev_2a505504e4634c45494730263b3e9dd7da9a8a53b707a6c6c2a02409b4820b58`

BifrOSt covers a Linux AT-SPI2 screen-reader bridge (roles, states, text attributes, text events, announcements, element notifications as signals, secure fields) and system display settings (zoom, reduce motion, increase contrast, reduce transparency, larger and bold text) that apps can read. Screen reader earcons, Speak Selection and a Braille line are wired in the shell. The hierarchy API is used by the sidebar, toolbar and sheets only. No Accessibility Inspector, Switch Control or Voice Control is wired, and Braille output and audio graphs have no device or request path yet.

Responder chain, key equivalents, menus, cursor shapes, gesture recognizers, scroll wheel and tracking-area models, typed drag and drop, dock badge, progress and menu, and an AT-SPI accessibility bridge exist. Since 2026-10-19 apps can ask for scroll wheel, pointer hover and two-finger magnify and rotate events (ToApp::Pointer), and the retained view kit has drag sources and drop destinations. Trackpad gesture events from the compositor, the cursor art in the compositor and Touch Bar (Apple-only) are missing.

An app returns the kinds it wants from App::pointer_interest (WHEEL, HOVER, GESTURES) and gets App::pointer calls; the runtime tells the shell (ToShell::PointerInterest), the shell sends the wheel at the position in the window and drops the emulated drag for that app, and sends Hover while the pointer is over the window content and HoverExit when it leaves. bifrost_ui::pointer_event::PointerRouter turns hover into the enter, exit and move events of tracking areas. <a id="core-foundation"></a>
### Core Foundation

Partial · coverage 78% · macOS 10.0 · [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/corefoundation) · REA `ev_20f07fbb6a8d75acd01162d9b322abeab9e8d8032ed51aa75f429dd312523baa`

Core Foundation is the C ABI layer (CFTypeRef, opaque CF* types, CFAllocator, run loops, sockets, plug-ins) that Apple bridges to Foundation. BifrOSt is Rust and has no C ABI requirement, so the CF types themselves are n/a. The Foundation-level behaviour they back (preferences, notifications, main queue, URLs, locale, formatting, plists) has partial counterparts in the Foundation batches.

Added later, host tests only: Shared host domains work across simulated apps on the host store; not yet wired into UserDefaults or the shell, and not checked on Midget |

### Distributed

Partial · coverage 80% · macOS 13.0 · [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/distributed) · REA `ev_a850e0bce106bf6bdcdabceab1374b66f8fb8c4e4b415cae3b6e765ee45a3d74`

Apple's Distributed framework is the Swift distributed actor model (actor systems, typed remote calls, local test system). BifrOSt has no actor system or typed remote-call encoder; its closest pieces are a cross-app broadcast (DistributedNotificationCenter) and a per-app JSON-RPC control socket, which cover the message-passing side but not location-transparent actor references.

| Feature | Apple API | BifrOSt | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Distributed actors and actor systems | DistributedActor, DistributedActorSystem, @Resolvable | none (no actor system in springboard/sdk/src/) | n/a | Swift language runtime feature; BifrOSt apps are Rust with no location-transparent actor references, so there is no counterpart to build on |
| Remote call targets and invocation encoding | RemoteCallTarget, RemoteCallArgument, DistributedTargetInvocationEncoder, DistributedTargetInvocationDecoder, DistributedTargetInvocationResultHandler | springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (handle_line, handle_line_ex, encode) | Parity | verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. JSON-RPC method dispatch with method names and JSON params exists; no typed invocation encoder/decoder, no target identifiers, no result-handler protocol |
| Cross-process broadcast messages | Distributed notifications (NSDistributedNotificationCenter-style delivery; Distributed framework docs do not cover it directly) | springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs (DistributedNotificationCenter, post_with, add_observer); springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (ToShell::DistPost relay); docs/bifrost-ui.md; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs | Partial | The shell relays posts to every running app; user_info is string to string with at most 32 entries. Headless tests: a_distributed_post_reaches_local_observers_and_is_queued_for_the_shell_sorted, a_process_local_distributed_post_sends_nothing_to_the_shell. No suspensionBehavior and no deliverImmediately; a plain post stays process-local. |
| Remote call errors | DistributedActorCodingError, DistributedActorSystemError, ExecuteDistributedTargetError | springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (RpcError, METHOD_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_PARAMS, INTERNAL_ERROR, TIMEOUT) | Parity | verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. JSON-RPC error codes cover method, params and timeout failures; no coding error type for typed arguments |
| Local testing actor system | LocalTestingDistributedActorSystem and its ActorID, Address, invocation encoder/decoder types | springboard/sdk/src/distributed.rs | Parity | verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. an in-process RPC test double for control methods would be the equivalent; none exists |
| Agent and tool access to running apps | No direct Distributed counterpart (remote invocation across processes) | springboard/mcp/src/ (agent MCP server); tools/app-control.py; tools/pi-bifrost-control/client.ts | OS only | The blocker is the design, not a missing API: agents reach apps through per-app control sockets that accept one JSON-RPC request per connection and only the owning user's connections, and through the MCP server, a host tool. Gaps: No location-transparent remote actor references or actor system; no SDK type for a remote handle to another app's object; No typed remote-call encoder or decoder: control methods pass untyped JSON params and results; No local test double for cross-process calls (LocalTestingDistributedActorSystem equivalent); Cross-app notifications are string-to-string only, capped at 32 entries and 1024 characters per value; Cross-app notifications have no suspensionBehavior: an app that is not running misses the post.

Progress is a tree of unit counts with child shares, fraction, finish, cancel, pause and resume that reach children with cancellation, pausing and resuming handlers, addChild, and current/becomeCurrent/resignCurrent (bifrost_ui::progress, reached as bifrost_app::controls::progress). Average throughput and seconds remaining come from progress_rate (headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-36.rs). Gap: no shared ProgressManager, no publishing progress to other processes, and no Handoff. |
| Resources (Bundle, localized strings) | Bundle, NSLocalizedString, NSBundleResourceRequest | springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs | Parity | verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. AppError carries domain, code, user info, localized description, failure reason, recovery suggestion and options, help anchor and underlying errors. <a id="foundation-models"></a>
### Foundation Models

Partial · coverage 77% · macOS 26.0 · [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundationmodels) · REA `ev_ab0c276e8f08660eff146ce88e3a628c67e0301757f4d384a0819607760d8663`

Apple's framework runs an on-device language model (SystemLanguageModel) with sessions, guided generation, tool calling and an optional Private Cloud Compute model. BifrOSt has no on-device model and no SDK API for model sessions, structured generation or model-invoked tools. Its only AI feature is the Assistant app, which calls a cloud Anthropic API over streaming HTTPS, and the SDK has App Intents and URLSession streaming that such a feature could use.

The hvf library renders HVGL hierarchical glyph parts for font editors and font tooling. BifrOSt's font engine reads TrueType variations (gvar) and CFF outlines but has no HVGL or HVF support, and no font editor needs it; the HVF format is an Apple font-tooling format with no counterpart on Linux.

The framework is audio analysis: a session that runs rhythm, key, loudness, pace, structure and instrument-activity analyses over a file or a buffer stream. The SDK has an analysis entry point (sdk/src/music_understanding.rs, analyze_interleaved) that gives rhythm (beats, bars, tempo), key over time, structure boundaries and loudness, tested in music_understanding::tests and music::tests. Pace is a model the session does not run yet, and instrument activity and source separation are not built.
